topic: Battle of Taranto: The First All-Aircraft Ship-to-Ship Attack
hook: How 21 biplanes crippled an entire battle fleet and inspired Pearl Harbor.
youtube_query: Battle of Taranto royal navy aircraft attack

evidence.title: 1940, 11-11: Second World War: The Royal Navy launched the first all-aircraft ship-to-ship naval attack in history against the Italians in the Battle of Taranto.

angle: How an obsolete biplane design and a daring night torpedo run at Taranto accidentally handed the Imperial Japanese Navy the exact blueprint for the attack on Pearl Harbor.
what_others_do: Existing content typically focuses on standard historical recounts of the battle's tactical timeline and British naval victory without connecting it to its global strategic aftermath.
